purpose: Canonical evidence shard for LORE Crypto History. Context, merged and moved discovery rows are excluded from independent card scoring.
note: 2019 fully reconciled from 71 discovery rows. Corrected cross-year events remain preserved in legacy/reconciliation files for incorporation into the proper year.

events.title: BBC launches The Missing Cryptoqueen podcast about OneCoin
events.summary: BBC Sounds launched The Missing Cryptoqueen in 2019, turning the OneCoin/Ruja Ignatova story into a major true-crime podcast phenomenon.
events.significance: The series significantly broadened awareness of OneCoin beyond crypto and financial-crime audiences.

sources.title: BBC / Apple Podcasts — The Missing Cryptoqueen

events.notes: BBC Sounds launched The Missing Cryptoqueen in 2019; retain as a culture/media event in the OneCoin story.

events.title: Fidelity Digital Assets begins institutional custody services
events.summary: Fidelity Digital Assets launched institutional custody and trade-execution client services in the United States in 2019.
events.significance: A major traditional financial institution offering crypto custody was a significant institutional-adoption milestone.

events.title: JPMorgan announces JPM Coin
events.summary: J.P. Morgan launched JPM Coin, a bank-issued digital representation of US-dollar deposits for institutional blockchain settlement.
events.significance: The product showed a systemically important bank adopting tokenized-money infrastructure even while public crypto remained controversial in traditional finance.

events.title: Unstoppable Domains launches .crypto on Ethereum
events.summary: Unstoppable Domains launched .crypto as an on-chain domain extension on Ethereum.
events.significance: Blockchain naming expanded beyond ENS and became a distinct Web3 identity and naming category.

events.title: QuadrigaCX collapse and missing-key saga
events.summary: QuadrigaCX shut down after founder Gerald Cotten's reported death and entered court-supervised proceedings. Later OSC review concluded the exchange owed clients roughly C$215 million with almost no assets available and that the shortfall resulted largely from Cotten's fraud and mismanagement, not simply inaccessible cold-wallet keys.
events.significance: Quadriga became one of crypto's defining custody and founder-control disasters and a cautionary tale about opaque exchange operations.

events.title: Lightning Torch travels globally across Twitter users
events.summary: The Lightning Torch began on 19 January 2019 and was passed between hundreds of participants across dozens of countries before reaching its protocol/payment limit.
events.significance: The #LNTrustChain experiment became Lightning's first major social demonstration of global, near-instant Bitcoin payments.

sources.title: Bitcoin Magazine — What We Can Learn About Lightning from #LNTrustChain2

events.title: Binance Launchpad's BitTorrent sale kick-starts the IEO era
events.summary: Binance Launchpad ran the BitTorrent Token sale in two sessions that sold out in under 15 minutes each.
events.significance: The sale became the flagship example of the exchange-led initial exchange offering model that briefly replaced ICOs as crypto's dominant retail fundraising format.

events.title: Wrapped Bitcoin brings BTC liquidity to Ethereum
events.summary: Wrapped Bitcoin (WBTC) officially launched on Ethereum as an ERC-20 token fully backed by Bitcoin held by custodians.
events.significance: WBTC created a bridge between Bitcoin liquidity and Ethereum applications and later became major DeFi collateral.

events.title: MolochDAO demonstrates minimalist on-chain governance
events.summary: MolochDAO was officially launched at ETHDenver on Valentine's Day 2019 as a deliberately minimal DAO for funding Ethereum public goods.
events.significance: Its 'ragequit' and minimalist governance design influenced a new generation of DAOs after the trauma of The DAO.

events.title: Stacking sats becomes a Bitcoin-community slogan
events.summary: The phrase 'stacking sats' had appeared publicly earlier, but Matt Odell's February 2019 advocacy helped turn regular small Bitcoin accumulation into a recognizable community movement; Jack Dorsey amplified it in March.
events.significance: Stacking sats became durable Bitcoin culture around incremental saving rather than whole-coin ownership.

sources.title: Lolli — History & Meaning Behind Stacking Sats

events.notes: Earliest public tweet cited by Lolli dates to 20 Dec 2017; 2019 is the popularization milestone, not the phrase's birth.

events.title: Synthetix.Exchange fully launches with sBTC and other Synths
events.summary: Synthetix released the full Synthetix.Exchange along with new Synths including sBTC.
events.significance: Synthetix became one of the earliest major DeFi derivatives/synthetic-asset protocols and showed how on-chain systems could create exposure to external asset prices without holding the underlying asset.

events.title: Craig Wright launches libel actions over challenges to his Satoshi claim
events.summary: Craig Wright began libel proceedings against critics who publicly rejected his claim to be Satoshi Nakamoto, including Peter McCormack; later judgments document the 2019 case.
events.significance: The litigation turned the long-running Satoshi-identity dispute into years of court proceedings and eventually contributed to later judicial findings about Wright's claims.

events.title: US charges OneCoin leaders as Konstantin Ignatov is arrested
events.summary: US prosecutors announced fraud and money-laundering charges against OneCoin leaders after Konstantin Ignatov had been arrested at Los Angeles International Airport on 6 March.
events.significance: The action marked a major criminal-enforcement phase in dismantling one of the world's largest fake-cryptocurrency schemes.

events.title: Cosmos mainnet launches
events.summary: Cosmos Hub launched its mainnet in March 2019 with an initial validator set, beginning the live Cosmos interchain ecosystem.
events.significance: Cosmos introduced a major multi-chain architecture built around sovereign zones, Tendermint consensus and later IBC interoperability.

sources.title: Cosmos Forum — Cosmos mainnet successful launch

events.notes: Launch was 14 March 07:08 Beijing time, approximately 13 March 23:08 UTC.

events.title: Bitmain launches the 7nm Antminer 17 generation
events.summary: Bitmain released its second-generation 7nm Antminer 17 series, including the S17 and S17 Pro, with materially improved hash rate and power efficiency.
events.significance: The S17 generation marked the post-2018 mining industry's shift into more efficient 7nm ASIC hardware.

sources.title: Bitmain — Antminer 17 Series specs and release times

events.title: Binance DEX launches on Binance Chain
events.summary: Binance DEX launched on the newly live BNB Chain, with public trading and BNB mainnet migration beginning the same day.
events.significance: The launch expanded Binance from a centralized exchange into its own blockchain and on-chain exchange ecosystem.

events.title: New York Attorney General investigates Bitfinex and Tether reserves
events.summary: The New York Attorney General obtained a court order in an investigation alleging that Bitfinex and Tether used transactions involving Tether reserves to conceal an apparent $850 million loss of co-mingled funds.
events.significance: The case became a major turning point in scrutiny of Tether's reserves and the relationship between the stablecoin issuer and Bitfinex.

sources.title: New York Attorney General — Bitfinex/Tether court order

events.title: FTX exchange launches
events.summary: FTX launched in or around May 2019 as a global cryptocurrency exchange founded by Sam Bankman-Fried and colleagues from Alameda Research.
events.significance: FTX grew from a new derivatives-focused venue into one of the world's largest exchanges before its spectacular 2022 collapse.

sources.title: US DOJ filing — FTX launched around May 2019

events.title: Wall Street Market darknet platform is seized
events.summary: US authorities announced charges against alleged administrators of Wall Street Market after an international investigation; the market had about 5,400 vendors and 1.15 million customer accounts.
events.significance: The takedown was one of the largest coordinated darknet-market enforcement actions of the post-Silk-Road era.

events.title: Binance suffers a major Bitcoin theft
events.summary: Attackers withdrew 7,000 BTC from Binance's hot wallet after obtaining API keys, 2FA codes and other information through multiple attack methods.
events.significance: It was Binance's defining exchange-security incident and became a major test of its SAFU user-protection reserve.

events.title: BitMEX reports an $11 billion single-day trading record
events.summary: BitMEX reported more than $11 billion of trading volume in a single day on 11 May 2019, led by its XBTUSD perpetual swap.
events.significance: The record illustrated the extraordinary scale reached by crypto perpetual swaps and BitMEX's influence on price discovery before later regulatory action.

sources.title: BitMEX — Thank You for Another Incredible Year

events.title: Cryptopia enters liquidation after hack
events.summary: Cryptopia was placed into liquidation after a January 2019 hack severely damaged the exchange.
events.significance: The collapse became a major New Zealand test case for whether cryptocurrencies held by an exchange are property held for customers.

events.title: Compound v2 launches on Ethereum mainnet
events.summary: Compound v2 launched on Ethereum mainnet with cTokens, autonomous interest-rate markets and improved collateral/risk architecture.
events.significance: Compound v2 helped establish pooled, algorithmic on-chain lending as a core DeFi primitive and became a foundation for the 2020 liquidity-mining boom.

events.title: Chainlink mainnet launches
events.summary: Chainlink launched on Ethereum mainnet as a decentralized oracle network connecting smart contracts to off-chain data.
events.significance: Chainlink solved a critical infrastructure problem for DeFi and became the dominant oracle layer for many smart-contract applications.

events.title: FATF introduces crypto Travel Rule framework
events.summary: FATF adopted updated standards and guidance applying AML/CFT obligations to virtual asset service providers, including the transfer-information requirement commonly called the Travel Rule.
events.significance: The move exported crypto AML compliance expectations across jurisdictions and reshaped exchange and wallet infrastructure globally.

sources.title: FATF — Guidance for Virtual Assets and VASPs

events.title: PlusToken becomes one of crypto's largest alleged Ponzi schemes
events.summary: PlusToken's organizers and promoters were linked to a large crypto investment scheme; Chainalysis later tracked roughly 180,000 BTC and other assets associated with it and reported that six people connected to the scheme were arrested in June 2019.
events.significance: PlusToken became one of the largest crypto investment-fraud cases of its era and a major case study in tracing large illicit on-chain flows.

sources.title: Chainalysis — Plustoken Scam: Tracking the $2 Billion in Cryptocurrency

events.notes: Asset/value totals vary by source; keep them attributed to Chainalysis or court findings rather than presenting one universal loss figure.

events.title: Facebook announces Libra
events.summary: Facebook announced plans for Calibra, a digital wallet intended to support Libra, a proposed global blockchain-based currency.
events.significance: Libra instantly moved stablecoins and private digital money into mainstream central-bank, parliamentary and regulatory debate.

events.title: Connext brings Ethereum state channels into production
events.summary: Connext's state-channel micropayments system was live in production by September 2019, while the Counterfactual and Magmo research groups merged work into the unified StateChannels project.
events.significance: It demonstrated that Ethereum state channels had moved from theory into production before rollups became the dominant scaling path.

sources.title: Ethereum Foundation — State Channel Research update

events.title: Gemini launches crypto-custody services
events.summary: Gemini launched Gemini Custody, a qualified-custodian platform for institutional crypto storage with expanded asset support and trading integration.
events.significance: Institutional-grade custody became a key prerequisite for hedge funds, asset managers and other regulated capital entering crypto.

events.title: Bakkt launches physically settled Bitcoin futures
events.summary: ICE Futures U.S. began trading Bakkt's daily and monthly physically settled Bitcoin futures contracts.
events.significance: Bakkt represented a major attempt to bring regulated institutional Bitcoin futures with physical delivery into traditional market infrastructure.

sources.title: ICE Futures U.S. — Bakkt Bitcoin futures launch reminder

events.title: Devcon5 convenes Ethereum's community in Osaka
events.summary: Ethereum's Devcon5 convened the global Ethereum developer community in Osaka, with the Ethereum 2.0 roadmap and research a major focus of the surrounding program.
events.significance: Devcon5 captured Ethereum at the transition point from early smart-contract growth toward proof-of-stake and scaling research.

sources.title: Ethereum Foundation — Devcon5 schedule and speakers

events.title: Telegram TON token sale faces SEC action
events.summary: The SEC filed an emergency action and obtained a temporary restraining order against Telegram and TON Issuer over an alleged unregistered $1.7 billion token offering.
events.significance: The case became one of the most important US enforcement actions against a large token financing and ultimately halted Telegram's original Gram distribution.

events.title: MakerDAO transitions toward Multi-Collateral Dai
events.summary: MakerDAO launched Multi-Collateral Dai, allowing Dai to be generated against more than one collateral type and renaming the original Single-Collateral Dai to Sai.
events.significance: MCD transformed Maker from an ETH-only stablecoin system into a broader DeFi credit platform and prepared Dai for much larger adoption.

sources.title: Maker Governance — Multi-Collateral Dai migration proposal

events.title: Gods Unchained opens its official blockchain-card marketplace
events.summary: Gods Unchained opened its official marketplace, allowing players to buy and sell blockchain-based game cards.
events.significance: The launch was an early proof that collectible card-game assets could be genuinely tradable blockchain property rather than items locked inside a game publisher's database.

events.title: Monero adopts RandomX proof-of-work
events.summary: Monero activated RandomX proof of work at block 1,978,433.
events.significance: RandomX aimed to keep Monero mining accessible to general-purpose CPUs and reduce the advantage of specialized ASIC hardware.

events.title: The Sandbox launches its first LAND presale
events.summary: The Sandbox launched its first LAND presale and reported that the first round sold out.
events.significance: The sale was an early milestone in the virtual-land/metaverse economy that would later explode during the 2021 NFT boom.

sources.title: The Sandbox — first LAND presale sold out

events.title: BitClub Network operators are charged over mining scheme
events.summary: US prosecutors charged several BitClub Network operators, alleging a cryptocurrency mining investment fraud that obtained at least $722 million from investors.
events.significance: BitClub became one of the largest mining-themed fraud prosecutions in crypto history.
events.notes: Use 'alleged' for the 2019 charging-stage description; later guilty pleas support parts of the government's case.

events.title: Gnosis Safe Multisig publicly launches
events.summary: Gnosis publicly launched Gnosis Safe Multisig, the successor to its earlier multisig wallet.
events.significance: Safe became foundational treasury and smart-account infrastructure for DAOs, protocols and crypto organizations.
